study: Buysse, Castro & Peisner-Feinberg (2010), Nuestros Ninos language/literacy PD for pre-K DLLs, ECRQ
eval_evidence: Authored/conducted by the Nuestros Ninos developers (Castro et al., UNC FPG Child Development Institute); the consultation model was 'developed and manualized by Buysse and Wesley.' Developer-conducted RCT, no independent evaluator.
developer_evidence: Delivered by the research team's own staff: two bilingual Latina consultants (graduate degrees) facilitated the institutes and individualized consultation; they were trained and supervised weekly by the research team. Developer-team delivery arm rather than school personnel.
cascade_evidence: Research-team consultants trained/supported the teachers directly; no train-the-trainer or lead-teacher tier where trainees then train other teachers (teachers do not re-deliver).
counterfactual_evidence: Control was business-as-usual (received institutes only at the end of the study). No alternative PD/program during the contrast.
coaching_evidence: Each consultant visited 'individual teachers once every other week' (biweekly) over the consultation window plus 'bimonthly visits to monitor a teacher's progress'; individualized in-class consultation on implementation - recurring in-class coaching cycles.
student_dose_evidence: Intervention changes the lead teacher's language/literacy practices; no tutoring, pull-out, or student-facing software dose added beyond regular classroom instruction.
maturity_evidence: Single school-year implementation (institutes at start, consultation across the year, spring outcomes); program designed as a one-year PD with no second-year/teacher-experience maturity axis.
